children: InPoint reduced its monthly distribution to $0.026 per share to align payouts with portfolio earnings and expected cash flows.
Board approved gross monthly distribution of $0.026 per share, payable to holders of record Sept 30, 2026.
Distributions payable in cash on or about Oct 19, 2026; net amounts for some classes reflect servicing fees.
Reduction reflects management view that prior distribution exceeded current portfolio earnings capacity and cash flow.
Company has resumed selective lending and is repositioning legacy investments to improve portfolio quality.
Board and management will engage an investment bank to evaluate strategic alternatives to enhance value and liquidity.
